searchText: Do you know if we have a spec for EL triggerable validator consolidations (even in progress)? Do we plan to add them to the next devnet (pectra-devnet-1?) ? i wrote this https://notes.ethereum.org/3xYSCuT0QsuEj8l9evWn_A but i think the latest approach with multiple message types supercedes it but generally, we just need to get the relevant data into the message bus, and then the CL accepts it and treats it just like a `Consolidation` in the CL specs right now cc: <@554799849288105986> as i think he's been looking into the EL triggerable consolidations spec? AFAIK we'd just reuse the contract for 7002 and change the data type Thank you <@539495253418180618> <@543900561460822016> 🙏
